title: JeffersonWM Project Activity public timeline
content:
JeffersonWM now has a public Project Activity page that turns the GitHub project board into a live timeline surface on the site itself. This pass focused on making project work legible to visitors without leaking private or archived repo data.

What changed:

  • Public project timeline: JeffersonWM now reads the public GitHub project through its own backend and renders issue durations directly on a dedicated public page.
  • Real workflow colors: issue lines now inherit the project board categories directly, so Backlog, Ready, In Progress, Blocked, and Done read visually without inventing a second status layer.
  • Cleaner public layout: repo/state filter controls were removed, the extra lower issues block was commented out for later, the date labels were moved to the top of the chart, and subtle row-hover highlighting now helps long lines stay connected to their issue titles.

The resulting page is less like an admin dashboard and more like a public working map of JeffersonWM development. It stays current from the JeffersonWM API while filtering private and archived repositories out before the browser ever sees them.
